name: News_Template_Universal
summary: This EA trades around scheduled economic news events by placing pending orders (buy stop and sell stop) at a configurable distance from the current price shortly before a news release. It captures the volatility spike following high-impact news announcements and manages positions with stop loss, take profit, trailing stop, and time-based expiration of pending orders.
summary_zh: 该EA在预定经济新闻事件发布前，以可配置的距离在当前价格上下放置止损挂单（Buy Stop和Sell Stop），捕捉高影响力新闻发布后的波动性飙升。它通过止损、止盈、移动止损和挂单定时到期机制来管理仓位。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于新闻交易（News Trading），即在高影响力经济数据发布前放置双向止损挂单，以捕捉发布后的大幅波动。入场条件为：EA检测到即将到来的新闻事件（通过内置日历或外部信号），在新闻发布前指定分钟数时，在当前价格上下方设定距离处分别放置Buy Stop和Sell Stop挂单。出场条件包括：达到止盈目标、触发止损、移动止损追踪获利、或新闻后指定时间内未成交的挂单自动删除。仓位管理通过手数参数控制，支持固定手数和基于资金的动态手数计算。资金管理方面，EA提供了最大滑点限制、最大持仓数量控制和新闻事件重要性过滤器。整体策略依赖新闻发布后的方向性突破，通过挂单捕捉 whichever direction the market breaks，属于典型的新闻事件驱动型交易策略。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on News Trading, placing directional pending orders on both sides of the current price before high-impact economic data releases to capture the subsequent volatility spike. Entry conditions: the EA detects upcoming news events via an economic calendar or external signal source, then places Buy Stop and Sell Stop orders at a configurable distance above and below the current price a specified number of minutes before the release. Exit conditions include hitting take profit targets, triggering stop loss, trailing stop profit protection, or automatic deletion of unfilled pending orders after a specified post-news timeout. Position sizing is controlled via lot size parameters, supporting both fixed lot sizing and equity-based dynamic lot calculation. Money management incorporates maximum slippage limits, maximum open position controls, and news event importance filters to restrict trading to high-impact events only. The overall strategy relies on directional breakout following news releases, capturing whichever direction the market breaks through the pending order trap, making it a classic event-driven trading approach.

parameters.name: NewsMinutesBefore
parameters.description: 新闻发布前多少分钟放置挂单
parameters.description_en: Minutes before news release to place pending orders

parameters.name: NewsMinutesAfter
parameters.description: 新闻发布后多少分钟删除未成交挂单
parameters.description_en: Minutes after news release to delete unfilled orders

parameters.name: OrderDistance
parameters.description: 挂单距离当前价格的点数
parameters.description_en: Pending order distance from current price in points

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, SL distance per order

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points per level

parameters.name: LotSize
parameters.description_en: Initial lot size, first order volume

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于识别订单
parameters.description_en: Magic number, unique EA order identifier

parameters.name: MinImpactLevel
parameters.description: 最低新闻重要性级别过滤

pros: 双向挂单策略不预判方向，捕捉新闻后无论涨跌的波动机会
具备完整的订单生命周期管理，包括挂单超时自动删除和移动止损保护利润
通过新闻重要性级别过滤，只交易高影响力事件，提高胜率
参数化设计灵活，可针对不同货币对和新闻类型调整距离和止损止盈
pros_en: Dual pending order strategy doesn't predict direction, capturing volatility opportunities regardless of whether price moves up or down after news
Complete order lifecycle management including automatic pending order expiration and trailing stop profit protection
News importance level filter restricts trading to high-impact events only, improving win rate
Flexible parameterized design allows adjustment of distance, SL/TP for different currency pairs and news types
cons: 新闻发布时滑点和报价间隙可能导致止损无法按预期执行，实际亏损可能远超设定止损
双向挂单在震荡行情中可能同时触发后双双止损，造成双重亏损
依赖经济日历数据的准确性，如果数据源延迟或缺失将错过交易机会
未考虑点差在新闻期间急剧扩大的情况，可能导致入场成本异常高昂
cons_en: Slippage and price gaps during news releases may prevent stop loss from executing as expected, resulting in losses far exceeding the configured SL
Dual pending orders can both be triggered in a whipsaw market, leading to double losses when both hit stop loss
Depends on accuracy of economic calendar data; delayed or missing data sources will cause missed trading opportunities
Does not account for spread widening dramatically during news periods, which can lead to abnormally high entry costs
improvements: 增加新闻期间最大点差过滤器，当点差超过阈值时暂停挂单放置
添加对已成交反向挂单的自动取消逻辑，避免双向同时持仓的风险
集成更可靠的多源经济日历数据，并增加数据有效性校验和降级机制
improvements_en: Add a maximum spread filter during news periods to suspend order placement when spread exceeds a threshold
Implement OCO (One-Cancels-Other) logic to automatically cancel the opposite pending order once one side is filled, avoiding simultaneous dual positions
Integrate more reliable multi-source economic calendar data with validation and fallback mechanisms for data availability

risk_points: 新闻发布期间滑点和报价间隙可能导致实际止损远大于设定值
双向挂单可能同时成交导致双重亏损风险
未对新闻期间点差扩大进行过滤保护
risk_points_en: Slippage and price gaps during news releases can cause actual stop loss to far exceed the configured value
Dual pending orders can both be filled simultaneously, creating double loss risk
No spread widening filter to protect against abnormally wide spreads during news events

It captures the volatility spike following high-impact news announcements and manages positions with stop loss, take profit, trailing stop, and time-based expiration of pending orders.
